Evidence Quality GatesLink

GateRequired AnswerIf Weak
Pricing qualityPricing governance supports quote, concession, margin, expiry, and recovery logic.Keep confidence from widening.
Response qualityResponse SLA shows dated acknowledgment, review status, decision timing, and payment structure.Do not treat silence as acceptance.
Cash and release qualityCash forecast, credit control, funding release, and pre-shipment release carry one answer.Block capital, supplier, broker, shipment, or payment movement.
Forecast qualityRevenue forecast band matches actual proof state.Keep the path as high-confidence, weighted, stretch, or lead instead of overpromoting it.
Retained memory qualityWon or lost records prove why the outcome happened and what should be reused or avoided.Do not use retained memory as precedent or re-entry basis yet.
